## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready safety laboratory records, standardizes test and normal-range categories, counts results by parameter and treatment, calculates percentages, and uses simulated Fisher exact tests for comparisons.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBC`
- `ADLBH`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: laboratory parameter
- `LBNRIND`: laboratory normal-range indicator
- `ANL01FL`: analysis-record flag
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment
- `ARM in ADSL`: treatment denominator label.
